unit: unique HTF_LINK context, not a trade or an outcome
selection: Earliest ten links recognized during the study, plus links still active at study start, sorted by max(link known_at, study_start), original event order. Retain only the first ten. No condition on tap, child, return, respect, entry review or favorable outcome.
decision_cutoff: Earliest CHILD_CANDIDATE in study for this link. If none, earliest HTF_TAP in study. If none, max(link known_at, study_start). Retain every same-cutoff branch. This is a retrospective navigation rule; no stage is labeled prospectively selected by this report.
decision_chart: Only source bars completed and events knowable by decision cutoff. Full available warmup-to-cutoff 4H and 1H context. Local 1M detail begins no later than earliest referenced origin/comparator/tap minus 30 minutes. No later outcomes appear in the decision image.
followthrough: Separate historical-development panels extend to frozen run end; include a separate local view through first recorded return plus 60 minutes when present, but never replace the full-to-end timeline. No eligibility inferred from absence of a later return event after retirement.
index: Every study MAJOR_BOS and M1_TRANSITION_BOS, including no-zone, no-tap, rejected and failed routes. Warmup events remain available as lineage.
authority: Research interpretation; teacher fidelity unverified; no fills, orders, profitability or Pepperstone parity claim
